properties.name: Bodhi Tree — Bodhgaya
properties.description: The sacred fig tree under which Siddhartha Gautama achieved enlightenment. The current tree is a descendant of the original.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, active pilgrimage center

properties.name: Lumbini — Birthplace of Buddha
properties.description: Garden where Queen Maya gave birth to Siddhartha Gautama. Ashoka's pillar (249 BCE) marks the exact spot of Buddha's birth.

properties.name: Boudhanath Stupa
properties.description: One of the largest stupas in the world. Its all-seeing eyes of Buddha gaze in all four directions. Center of Tibetan Buddhism in Nepal.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, active Buddhist center

properties.name: Potala Palace
properties.description: Former winter residence of the Dalai Lama in Lhasa. 1,000 rooms rising 117m on the Red Hill. Seat of Tibetan Buddhist spiritual authority.

properties.name: Bagan — City of Temples
properties.description: Over 2,200 surviving temples and pagodas across the Bagan plain. At its peak, over 10,000 Buddhist structures covered this landscape.

properties.name: Borobudur
properties.description: World's largest Buddhist temple — a massive mandala in stone with 504 Buddha statues and 2,672 relief panels telling the journey to enlightenment.
properties.modernStatus: UNESCO World Heritage Site, New Seven Wonders candidate

properties.name: Sarnath — First Sermon
properties.description: Where the Buddha delivered his first sermon, 'Setting the Wheel of Dharma in Motion,' to five ascetics. Ashoka's lion capital stands here.

properties.name: Sigiriya — Lion Rock
properties.description: Ancient rock fortress rising 200m with frescoes of celestial maidens, mirror wall, and lion gateway. Built by King Kashyapa as his citadel.

properties.name: Shwedagon Pagoda
properties.description: Golden stupa in Yangon rising 99m, covered in 60 tons of gold leaf and topped with thousands of diamonds. Contains relics of four Buddhas.
properties.modernStatus: Active pagoda, most sacred Buddhist site in Myanmar

properties.name: Taktsang (Tiger's Nest) Monastery
properties.description: Buddhist monastery clinging to a cliff 900m above the Paro Valley. Guru Rinpoche flew here on a tiger's back to meditate in the cave.
properties.modernStatus: Active monastery, Bhutan's most iconic site

properties.name: Adam's Peak (Sri Pada)
properties.description: Mountain with a rock formation resembling a footprint — claimed by Buddhists (Buddha), Hindus (Shiva), Muslims (Adam), and Christians (St. Thomas).
properties.modernStatus: Active pilgrimage site for all four religions
